p='te/algorithms/sub_algorithms/pgd.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''def sharing_gradient(amounts, hessian, linear):
    raise NotImplementedError('complete capacity-scaled global sharing gradient')'''
new='''def sharing_gradient(amounts, hessian, linear):
    """Capacity-scaled gradient of the sharing objective 0.5 x'Qx + q'x."""
    amounts = np.asarray(amounts, dtype=float)
    if hessian is None:
        return np.asarray(linear, dtype=float).copy()
    grad = np.asarray(hessian, dtype=float) @ amounts
    if linear is not None:
        grad = grad + np.asarray(linear, dtype=float)
    return grad'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)

p='te/algorithms/formulations/path_based/distributed/coordinator.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    def retune(self, rho):
        raise NotImplementedError('complete offline sharing/recovery semantics')

    def step(self, x, active, mode):
        raise NotImplementedError('complete offline sharing/recovery semantics')'''
new='''    def retune(self, rho):
        """Change the penalty, rescaling the scaled dual so rho*u is fixed."""
        if rho <= 0:
            raise ValueError('rho must be positive')
        old = self._outer_admm_wrapper.step_size
        dual = np.asarray(self._outer_admm_wrapper.dual_var, dtype=float)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.rescale(rho)
        self._mlu_solver.rho = float(rho)
        self._rho = float(rho)
        return dual * (float(old) / float(rho))

    def step(self, x, active, mode):
        """One consensus projection: z, h, pressure and the updated scaled dual."""
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
        if active is None:
            active = np.ones(x.shape[0], dtype=bool)
        active = np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
        self._mlu_solver.active = active
        self._mlu_solver.update_F_m(np.where(active, x, 0.0))
        if mode is not None:
            self._mlu_solver._objective = mode
        z, h, t = self._mlu_solver.solve()
        alpha = self._alpha
        u0 = np.asarray(self._outer_admm_wrapper.dual_var, dtype=float)
        z0 = np.asarray(self._outer_admm_wrapper.Z, dtype=float)
        u = u0 + alpha * x + (1.0 - alpha) * z0 - z
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.record_Z_update(z)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.record_dual_update(u)
        return z, float(h), t, u'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('''    def __init__(self, n, rho, alpha):
        self._outer_admm_wrapper = ADMMWrapper(n, rho, alpha=alpha)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.initialize(np.zeros(n))
        self._mlu_solver = PDLPMLU(n, rho, 'route')''','''    def __init__(self, n, rho, alpha):
        self._alpha = float(alpha)
        self._rho = float(rho)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper = ADMMWrapper(n, rho, alpha=alpha)
        self._outer_admm_wrapper.initialize(np.zeros(n))
        self._mlu_solver = PDLPMLU(n, rho, 'route')''')
